commitment: Final brand spend (logo, signage, packaging, domain, merch)
required_inputs: ip_attorney view; D-79/D-80 resolved by founder after counsel
pass: Counsel supports use or a modified name; founder decides
hold: Counsel not yet heard, or MODERATE/HIGH risk with no decision
fail: Counsel advises against, or conflict is confirmed and unresolved
capital_protected: All name-dependent spend; the ability to rename cheaply
stop_statement: DO NOT SPEND ON NAME-DEPENDENT ASSETS YET

required_inputs: Dish passed internal gates (s1_sensory); food permit path verified; food_cost layer computed; alcohol excluded or legally cleared; neutral external wording
decision_owner: Founder, after professional confirmation of the permit path
fail: A prerequisite shows the test cannot lawfully run
capital_protected: Cash, reputation, a possible permit problem
stop_statement: DO NOT RUN A PAID TEST YET

hold: Menu still changing or no quote
fail: Equipment would sit idle or the kitchen cannot host the Core 5

required_inputs: Repeat demand behavior; real unit economics at event scale; throughput measured; permit/commissary path verified; financing sized to maximum loss exposure

hold: Demand evidence is single-event or intent only
fail: Break-even covers exceed measured kitchen capacity (fin_model capacity_warning)

hold: Any of demand, financing, or diligence unknown
fail: Break-even exceeds capacity or diligence finds an unfixable barrier
capital_protected: Lease obligations (largest irreversible item before construction)
stop_statement: DO NOT SIGN A LEASE YET

hold: Beer path unvalidated or legal route unknown
